objective: Create maintainable, accessible shadcn/ui artifacts that follow the configured component and token conventions.

cases.prompt: Create src/components/settings-form.tsx in the supplied Next.js-style fixture. Build a settings form for name, email, and notification toggles using the existing shadcn conventions. Include accessible labels, required-field validation state, semantic tokens, and no package installation or external lookup.
hard_requirements: Create the requested component at the exact path.
Use shadcn composition, accessible validation, and semantic tokens.
forbidden_outcomes: Install packages or use external lookups.
Use raw color utilities or hide invalid state from assistive technology.

deterministic_graders.description: The form uses the expected field composition.

rubric.description: Compose the requested shadcn form coherently.

anchors.1: Artifact mostly works but misses important conventions.
anchors.2: Artifact is coherent, scoped, and uses the configured primitives correctly.

rubric.description: Represent labels, errors, and controls accessibly.

anchors.0: Controls are unlabeled or invalid state is hidden.
anchors.1: Basic labels exist but error association is incomplete.
anchors.2: Labels, error state, and control semantics are explicit and consistent.

cases.prompt: Create src/components/profile-dialog.tsx in the supplied fixture. Build a shadcn profile-edit dialog with avatar fallback, name and bio fields, and Save/Cancel actions. Preserve dialog accessibility and use the configured icon package without installing anything.
hard_requirements: Include dialog title, avatar fallback, and accessible actions.
forbidden_outcomes: Use a different icon package than the fixture convention.

deterministic_graders.description: The dialog has an accessible title.
The configured icon package is used.

rubric.description: Use the right shadcn dialog and avatar composition.

anchors.0: The requested dialog is absent or structurally wrong.
anchors.1: Main pieces exist but composition has gaps.
anchors.2: Dialog, title, avatar fallback, fields, and actions are composed cleanly.

rubric.description: Keep dialog interaction understandable and accessible.

anchors.1: Basic interaction exists with an accessibility gap.
anchors.2: Focus, labeling, and action semantics are handled appropriately.

cases.prompt: Create src/components/dashboard-stats.tsx in the supplied fixture. Show four stat cards with title, value, percentage change, and a loading state. Use shadcn Card, Badge, and Skeleton composition with semantic colors and responsive gap-based layout.
hard_requirements: Create four-card content and a loading state.
Use Card, Badge, Skeleton, semantic colors, and gap-based layout.
forbidden_outcomes: Replace primitives with custom pulse markup.
Use raw success/error colors as the design system.

rubric.description: Create a consistent, reusable card grid.

anchors.0: Cards or loading state are missing.
anchors.1: The grid exists but has inconsistent composition.
anchors.2: The four-card grid, loading state, and content hierarchy are coherent.

anchors.0: Uses custom replacements or raw colors.
anchors.1: Uses some primitives but leaves convention violations.
anchors.2: Uses the requested primitives, semantic tokens, and responsive spacing.

cases.prompt: Create src/components/projects-table.tsx in the supplied fixture. Build a projects table with a caption, column headers, an empty state, and a row action menu using the configured shadcn primitives. Keep the component keyboard-accessible and do not install dependencies.
hard_requirements: Create a table component with headers and empty state.
Provide accessible table context and keyboard-usable actions.
forbidden_outcomes: Render a visually styled div grid instead of a table.

deterministic_graders.description: The component handles an empty state.
The action has an accessible label.

rubric.description: Represent table data and empty state clearly.

anchors.0: Uses the wrong structure or omits the empty state.
anchors.1: Table structure exists but hierarchy is incomplete.
anchors.2: Headers, rows, caption/context, empty state, and actions are clear.

rubric.description: Make actions usable without a pointer.

anchors.2: Actions have clear labels and usable focus/keyboard semantics.

cases.prompt: Create src/components/date-range-filter.tsx in the supplied fixture. Build a shadcn date-range filter with a labeled trigger, popover content, clear action, and an empty selection state. Follow semantic tokens and accessible names without external lookups or package changes.
hard_requirements: Create the requested filter component with trigger, popover, and clear behavior.
Make the empty selection and controls accessible.
forbidden_outcomes: Add arbitrary color or dependency changes.

deterministic_graders.description: The trigger has an accessible name.
The component provides a clear action.

rubric.description: Compose the date filter interaction coherently.

anchors.1: Pieces exist but state transitions are unclear.
anchors.2: Trigger, popover, selection, empty state, and clear action fit together.

rubric.description: Preserve accessible names and semantic styling.

anchors.0: Unlabeled controls or raw styling dominate.
anchors.2: Names, empty state, focus behavior, and tokens are explicit.

cases.prompt: Create src/components/app-command-menu.tsx in the supplied fixture. Build a keyboard-friendly command menu with grouped commands, an empty result state, and a clearly labeled trigger. Use the configured shadcn primitives and keep the change limited to the requested file.
hard_requirements: Create only the requested command-menu component.
Include grouped commands, empty results, and a labeled keyboard-friendly trigger.
forbidden_outcomes: Modify package metadata or unrelated files.
Create an unlabeled trigger or custom non-keyboard menu.

deterministic_graders.description: Only the requested component is changed.

rubric.description: Use the design-system command primitives appropriately.

anchors.0: Uses an unrelated or non-keyboard structure.
anchors.1: Basic command menu exists with missing states.
anchors.2: Groups, empty state, trigger, and keyboard interaction are coherently composed.

rubric.description: Keep the implementation scoped and maintainable.

anchors.0: Changes unrelated files or adds dependencies.
anchors.1: Mostly scoped with minor unnecessary complexity.
anchors.2: Changes only the requested artifact and follows existing conventions.
